notes: reviewReuse now requires the observed original/reused process identity, the same process start on the REUSED instance and the original PID; deleting the observation, a null/empty/mismatched start or a different PID is rejected.

stages.title: Digest and refusal observations are required

Every different/missing/port/unbound request needs a real BLOCKED terminal with a code, so RUNNING on the original PID without a reused flag or a missing observation is rejected. The real report is the positive; four single-observation mutations and the foreign consumer are rejected.
